'''Vano Baruk''' was a renowned [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] active during the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a proxy conflict between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He bribed officials of both factions with millions of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Eventually someone was sent to [[Slicer/Legends|slice]] Baruk's [[Computer/Legends|computer]] terminals to discover who he was bribing.<ref name="SLI" />
